messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: multiple serving nodes in pool 'gen-large-gpu' reporting OOM + CUDA errors. 12 restarts in 5m, error rate spike 4.8x. auto-scale not triggered due to capacity cap.

maya: I'm on it. beginning triage — which model pool(s) impacted? any customer-facing 5xxs? @support-jules take customer notes.

devon: logs from node gpu-07:
```
[2026-03-15T03:02:12Z] runtime: cudaErrorIllegalAddress at allocateKernel.cu:211
[2026-03-15T03:02:12Z] runtime: OutOfMemory: device 0, requested 524288000, free 0
[2026-03-15T03:02:12Z] allocator: failed to allocate paged-attn KV slab, fragmentation > 0.92
```
This looks like allocator fragmentation, slow memory creep leading to hard OOM. Paging traffic concurrent with long-context requests.

chen: +1 to allocator fragmentation. Symptoms match KV cache slow accumulation — lots of small evictions not happening because of stale slot refs. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) disable attention paging on the most-trafficked model variant (REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=0) 2) issue KV eviction to free stale prefixes 3) roll a canary with new allocator flags (--enable-slab-defrag=true --kv-stale-ttl=3600).

ops-lars: I can take the rollout. We'll do a config patch to a subset (3/10 nodes) first. Prepare curl for internal eviction API?

deponly: (deploy-bot) Received patch request, starting canary update to gen-large-gpu pool: nodes gpu-02,gpu-06,gpu-09.

maya: support-jules any customer reports?

support-jules: We have 2 customers reporting increased 500s and timeouts in the last 7m. Example request ids: req_8432, req_8491. They see latency spikes >10s before failing. I pinged account teams for the two customers — ETA on statement?

devon: quick mitigation in-flight: reducing max_tokens default in router to 512 and lowering per-request concurrency to 1 for the pool to reduce KV churn. Applying now.

chen: Eviction API snippet (internal):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/sv1/evict-kv" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"pool":"gen-large-gpu","evict_age_seconds":3600}'
```
This will purge KV entries older than 1h. Use conservatively.

ops-lars: Rolling canary started. Noting we cannot disable paging globally until we confirm latency tradeoffs. Canary nodes show fewer OOMs so far (0 -> 1 vs 6 -> 12).

deploy-bot: Can confirm canary config applied. 3/10 nodes now have REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=0 + allocator flags.

devon: Observing improved stability on canary, but one node reported slow GC during defrag attempt with increased CPU spike. CPU on those nodes went up ~18%. Keeping canary small.

maya: Customer impact summary: sev2 for now. Affected customers: acct-42 (production), acct-99 (staging). Estimated ct: 2% of total requests in the pool failing. I'll update status page and CS. @pm-reena FYI.

pm-reena: thanks, please include ETA for a full rollback or mitigation and note suggestion for postmortem root cause + customer communication plan.

chen: For medium-term: we should implement periodic compaction in allocator (background pass to coalesce free slabs) and add metrics: kv_free_runs, slab_fragmentation_ratio per-pool. Short-term patch we just rolled sets KV_STALE_TTL=3600 which will reduce accumulation.

maya: Action items: 1) finish canary + monitor 15m 2) if stable, roll to remaining nodes with 10% steps 3) support to prepare customer message for 2% failure + mitigation steps 4) postmortem owners devon + chen.

support-jules: I'll draft customer comms: note degraded success rate and that we're actively mitigating. ETA for first notice: 20m.

sre-bot: INCIDENT severity changed: Sev2 -> active. Incident lead: maya. Paging: oncall eng on duty.

devon: quick note on workaround we pushed: allocator now aggressively frees KV slots referenced > 1h and triggers eviction on low memory. Code diff (sketch):
```
if (kv_entry.last_used > now - KV_STALE_TTL) { mark_for_eviction(entry); }
if (fragmentation > 0.85) { trigger_slab_compact_async(); }
```
Canary telemetry shows OOM-rate drop ~70% on patched nodes.

ops-lars: Rolling to remaining nodes now with 10% increments. Will pause if OOMs spike > baseline.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 30% -> 60% -> 100% (completed). No regressions in next 8m on canaries.

maya: All nodes rolled. Monitoring: error-rate back down to near baseline but latency still elevated ~8%. We'll keep throttles in place for 30m then reassess.

chen: Filing follow-up ticket: RH-alloc-1087 — add periodic compaction + better eviction heuristics + exposing slab_fragmentation metrics. Prioritize P1 for runtime team.

devon: I will own the hotfix PR to add compaction and the KV stale tracer. Plan: canary in 24h, full rollout after smoke test.

support-jules: Customer updates queued. Will provide a summary once incident moves to mitigation.

maya: Great work team. Postmortem owners devon + chen. I'll rotate this to incident review channel in 48h. :thumbsup:

ops-lars: Leaving detailed node handoff notes in eng-oncall channel.

sre-bot: INCIDENT resolved -> mitigation applied. Monitoring for 6h.

(reactions: :rocket: from devon, :heart: from support-jules, :relieved: from maya)
